Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses APEX2 proximity labeling followed by streptavidin enrichment. While the PRIDE metadata mentions 'Affinity purification', the specific method is proximity labeling (APEX), which maps to mod_proximity_labeling.

scope: For streptavidin pull-down, 1 mg of the protein lysate was incubated with streptavidin-conjugated agarose beads (Thermo Fisher) at room temperature for 2 h.
To elute the biotinylated proteins, the beads were incubated with a 3× sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS)–polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis (PAGE) loading buffer containing 2 mM biotin at 95 °C for 5 min.
The proteins were digested in gel with trypsin, and the resultant peptide mixture was dried in a Speed-vac and desalted using OMIX C18 pipette tips (Agilent Technologies).
The desalted peptides were dissolved in 0.1% formic acid and subjected to LC–MS/MS analysis
